description: Implement Java 21 Spring Boot catalog API with uniqueness and strict validation
scenario: Fresh service; do not import the evaluation script into the agent workspace.
requirements: POST /api/books accepts {isbn,title,stock} and returns 201 JSON {isbn,title,stock}; ISBN and title nonblank, stock integer >= 0
GET /api/books/{isbn} returns 200 matching JSON, or 404 if absent
POST duplicate ISBN returns 409, does not mutate original book
Invalid or unknown JSON properties are rejected with 4xx (not 2xx)
GET /actuator/health or GET /health reports 200 during evaluation
language: Java 21; Spring Boot 4; persistent storage optional for this bounded task
